scope.externalLabelRegions: Independent current-native verifier:324 designators+24 board strings=348; four callout POLYs separately checked

limits: All CAM primitives are composed in export order with dark/clear polarity; arc approximation error <=0.001mm.
Actual exported ink overlap is a collision; conservative native text envelope overlap alone is not. Export clipping and glyph whitespace require actual glyph review.
The unchanged source CAM is a footprint glyph witness only; old designator or testpoint poses are not applied to the final board.
No claim of OCR, a native-font renderer, or missing footprint-outline reconstruction. Native text identity/pose and source-baseline regions are bound separately.
No automatic footprint edits; all 12 glyphs need visual reading of the emitted actual-CAM montage.
Clipped native straight-outline exposure is classified separately from surviving actual exported ink; no unprovided factory preprocessing is assumed.

nativeFootprintOutlineClippingDiagnostic.method: Only native straight POLY strokes, exact pose/width. Native text envelopes and unsupported arcs never establish clipping.
